messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands on an asphalt road, initially looking to his left, then raises his right hand to touch his chin and mouth before lowering it and turning his head to look forward.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A dark gray military-style uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, gold star insignia on the chest, a brown belt with a gold buckle, and brown leather shoes.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Black hair pulled back into a high ponytail with a few loose strands at the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult male with a medium-brown complexion, a short beard, and a slim build.","scene":"An outdoor paved road beneath a concrete overpass with metal railings, red-and-yellow striped hazard posts, and a construction crane visible in the background under a blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a bright rooftop with antennas and buildings to an asphalt road beneath a concrete overpass with railings, hazard posts, and a crane, matching the reference. The character remains in a similar full-body low-angle framing and performs the same standing, chin-touching, and head-turning sequence. The character's lighting and overall color tone became darker and warmer, consistent with the new environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the rooftop scene with the reference overpass/road environment while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing, and adapt the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the uniform color change is solely due to lighting adaptation or an unintended material change.
unexpected_changes: The uniform appears darker and more brownish-gray in the output than the bluish-gray in the source, likely due to lighting adaptation but also a visible color shift.
